definitions.gloss: good book; worthwhile book; quality reading
definitions.explanation: A book considered to be of high quality or educational value. Often used in discussions about reading habits, recommendations, or education.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{良書|りょうしょ}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧みて。
examples.english: This is a good book, so give it a read.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{良書|りょうしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えたい→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: I want to give children good books to read.

examples.japanese: ⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{司書|ししょ}→司書：07032_shisho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧{良書|りょうしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リスト→リスト：09786_risuto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A list of quality books selected by the librarian was published.

notes:
A somewhat formal word used to describe a book of recognized quality or educational merit. Often appears in contexts related to reading recommendations, education, and children's literature.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {良書|りょうしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{薦|すす}める→薦める：27814_susumeru⟧ (to recommend a good book)
- {良書|りょうしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{親|した}しむ→親しむ：14139_shitashimu⟧ (to become familiar with good books)
- {良書|りょうしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧ (to choose quality books)

The opposite is {悪書|あくしょ} (harmful or low-quality book). Both terms carry a value judgment and are commonly used in educational and literary contexts.
